engagements.title: YDSP Science & Technology Camp
engagements.details: Attended the 4-day residential S&T Camp at DSTA HQ. Hands-on workshops covering robotics, cybersecurity, and defence systems design.

engagements.title: Research@YDSP
engagements.details: 8-week research attachment at DSTA's Programmes directorate. Developed an obstacle-avoidance algorithm for small UAVs using computer vision, mentored by Dr. Ho Wei Lin (Principal Engineer).

engagements.title: YDSP Congress

engagements.title: Junior College 2021 Internship
engagements.details: 6-week internship at DSTA's Command, Control & Communications (C3) Systems department. Contributed to RF frequency planning tool development.

engagements.title: Singapore Airshow 2022
engagements.details: Attended as a DSTA guest delegate. Participated in DSTA-organised panel on autonomous systems and engaged with defence industry partners.

engagements.title: Tech UP
